note: Ten of one place make one of the next: development cases for need 35P-04, 2026-11-27, written from place-value-times-ten-blueprint.json (rows T1-T5). Used for design and tuning; the scoring set is separate, written later by a fresh agent from the blueprint alone, sealed. Never taken from the question set. PF-01 to PF-15 are cases this need serves (8 en-US, 7 zh-CN; 9 count, 6 times; 8 whole numbers, 7 decimals). expect.ask is count (an amount counted in another unit: expect.amount shown at first as disks of expect.start, counted in expect.target; expect.result the count) or times (expect.amount against expect.target, the same digit one place right; expect.renamed is the amount counted in the target's place, expect.result is 10). Numbers are plain decimal strings. PF-16 to PF-22 are near misses that belong to other needs (expect.need names it): this need's component must not be used (forbid names the tentative recipe). Chinese cases use 个百、个十分之一、几倍、十分之一, as Chinese learners say them.
